# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) solver using Pyomo + IPOPT.

Implements the complex-power AC-OPF formulation from math-model.md
using rectangular voltage coordinates (Vr, Vi) for smooth NLP.
"""

import json
import math
import numpy as np
import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
with open("/root/network.json") as f:
    raw = json.load(f)

baseMVA = raw["baseMVA"]

# --- buses ---
buses = {}
for b in raw["bus"]:
    bid = int(b[0])
    buses[bid] = {
        "type": int(b[1]),   # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Ref
        "Pd": b[2] / baseMVA,
        "Qd": b[3] / baseMVA,
        "Gs": b[4] / baseMVA,
        "Bs": b[5] / baseMVA,
        "Vm": b[7],
        "Va": math.radians(b[8]),
        "vmax": b[11],
        "vmin": b[12],
    }

bus_ids = sorted(buses.keys())
ref_buses = [i for i in bus_ids if buses[i]["type"] == 3]

# --- generators ---
gens = []
gen_cost = []
for idx, (g, gc) in enumerate(zip(raw["gen"], raw["gencost"])):
    if g[7] == 0.0:  # skip out-of-service
        continue
    gens.append({
        "id": idx + 1,
        "bus": int(g[0]),
        "Pg": g[1] / baseMVA,
        "Qg": g[2] / baseMVA,
        "Qmax": g[3] / baseMVA,
        "Qmin": g[4] / baseMVA,
        "Vg": g[5],
        "Pmax": g[8] / baseMVA,
        "Pmin": g[9] / baseMVA,
    })
    # polynomial cost: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0  (Pg in MW for cost)
    # ncost = int(gc[3])
    gen_cost.append({
        "c2": gc[4],
        "c1": gc[5],
        "c0": gc[6],
    })

gen_ids = list(range(len(gens)))

# Map bus -> list of generator indices
bus_gens = {i: [] for i in bus_ids}
for k, g in enumerate(gens):
    bus_gens[g["bus"]].append(k)

# --- branches ---
branches = []
for b in raw["branch"]:
    if b[10] == 0.0:  # skip out-of-service
        continue
    fbus = int(b[0])
    tbus = int(b[1])
    r = b[2]
    x = b[3]
    bc = b[4]  # total line charging susceptance
    rateA = b[5] / baseMVA  # MVA limit in pu
    tap = b[8]
    shift = math.radians(b[9])
    angmin = math.radians(b[11])
    angmax = math.radians(b[12])

    if tap == 0.0:
        tap = 1.0  # default tap

    # Series admittance
    z = complex(r, x)
    y = 1.0 / z if abs(z) > 0 else complex(0, 0)

    # Pi-model parameters
    # Y_ij = y (series admittance)
    # Y^c_ij = j*bc/2  (from-side charging)
    # Y^c_ji = j*bc/2  (to-side charging)
    # T_ij = tap * exp(j*shift)

    branches.append({
        "fbus": fbus,
        "tbus": tbus,
        "y_re": y.real,
        "y_im": y.imag,
        "bc": bc,       # total charging
        "rateA": rateA,
        "tap": tap,
        "shift": shift,
        "angmin": angmin,
        "angmax": angmax,
    })

branch_ids = list(range(len(branches)))

# Bus -> list of (branch_idx, is_from)
bus_branches = {i: [] for i in bus_ids}
for k, br in enumerate(branches):
    bus_branches[br["fbus"]].append((k, True))
    bus_branches[br["tbus"]].append((k, False))

print(f"System: {len(bus_ids)} buses, {len(gens)} generators, {len(branches)} branches")
print(f"Reference bus(es): {ref_buses}")
total_pd = sum(buses[i]["Pd"] for i in bus_ids) * baseMVA
total_qd = sum(buses[i]["Qd"] for i in bus_ids) * baseMVA
print(f"Total load: {total_pd:.2f} MW, {total_qd:.2f} MVAr")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build Pyomo Model  (rectangular V formulation)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pyo.ConcreteModel("ACOPF")

# Sets
model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=bus_ids)
model.G = pyo.Set(initialize=gen_ids)
model.E = pyo.Set(initialize=branch_ids)

# Variables
model.Vr = pyo.Var(model.N, initialize=1.0)  # real part of voltage
model.Vi = pyo.Var(model.N, initialize=0.0)  # imaginary part

model.Pg = pyo.Var(model.G, initialize=0.5)
model.Qg = pyo.Var(model.G, initialize=0.0)

# Initialize voltages from flat start / data
for i in bus_ids:
    vm = buses[i]["Vm"]
    va = buses[i]["Va"]
    model.Vr[i].value = vm * math.cos(va)
    model.Vi[i].value = vm * math.sin(va)

# Initialize generators
for k in gen_ids:
    model.Pg[k].value = gens[k]["Pg"]
    model.Qg[k].value = gens[k]["Qg"]

# Generator bounds
for k in gen_ids:
    model.Pg[k].setlb(gens[k]["Pmin"])
    model.Pg[k].setub(gens[k]["Pmax"])
    model.Qg[k].setlb(gens[k]["Qmin"])
    model.Qg[k].setub(gens[k]["Qmax"])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Branch power flow expressions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For branch k from bus i to bus j:
#   T = tap * exp(j*shift) = tap*(cos(shift) + j*sin(shift))
#   |T|^2 = tap^2
#
# S_ij = (y + j*bc/2)* |Vi|^2 / |T|^2  -  y* Vi*Vj* / T
# S_ji = (y + j*bc/2)* |Vj|^2           -  y* Vi**Vj / T*
#
# In rectangular coordinates, V_i = Vr_i + j*Vi_i:
#   |V_i|^2 = Vr_i^2 + Vi_i^2
#   V_i * V_j* = (Vr_i*Vr_j + Vi_i*Vi_j) + j*(Vi_i*Vr_j - Vr_i*Vi_j)
#   V_i * V_j* / T = [(Vr_i*Vr_j + Vi_i*Vi_j)*(tc) + (Vi_i*Vr_j - Vr_i*Vi_j)*(ts)] / tap^2
#                   + j*[(Vi_i*Vr_j - Vr_i*Vi_j)*(tc) - (Vr_i*Vr_j + Vi_i*Vi_j)*(ts)] / tap^2
#   where tc = tap*cos(shift), ts = tap*sin(shift)

def Pf_expr(model, k):
    """Real power flow from bus (from side)"""
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    g_s = br["y_re"]  # series conductance
    b_s = br["y_im"]  # series susceptance
    bc = br["bc"]
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift = br["shift"]
    tap2 = tap * tap
    tc = tap * math.cos(shift)
    ts = tap * math.sin(shift)

    Vri = model.Vr[i]
    Vii = model.Vi[i]
    Vrj = model.Vr[j]
    Vij = model.Vi[j]

    Vm2_i = Vri**2 + Vii**2
    # Real part of (y + j*bc/2)* = g_s - j*(b_s + bc/2) ... conjugate
    # (y + j*bc/2)* |Vi|^2 / |T|^2
    # Re: g_s * Vm2_i / tap2
    # Im: -(b_s + bc/2) * Vm2_i / tap2

    # V_i * V_j* / T:
    # Let A = Vri*Vrj + Vii*Vij  (Re of Vi*Vj*)
    # Let B = Vii*Vrj - Vri*Vij  (Im of Vi*Vj*)
    # Vi*Vj*/T = (A*tc + B*ts)/tap2 + j*(B*tc - A*ts)/tap2
    A = Vri * Vrj + Vii * Vij
    B = Vii * Vrj - Vri * Vij

    # S_ij = (g_s - j(b_s+bc/2)) * Vm2_i / tap2  -  (g_s - j*b_s) * [Vi*Vj*/T]
    # Re(S_ij):
    Pf = g_s * Vm2_i / tap2 \
         - g_s * (A * tc + B * ts) / tap2 \
         - (-b_s) * (B * tc - A * ts) / tap2
    # Note: y* = g_s - j*b_s, so Re(-y* * (X+jY)) = -g_s*X + b_s*Y
    # Correction: -y* * Z = -(g_s - j*b_s)*(X+jY) = -g_s*X - b_s*(-Y) ... let me redo carefully
    # Actually: S_ij = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ij) * |Vi|^2/|T|^2  -  conj(Y_ij) * Vi*Vj*/T
    # conj(Y_ij) = g_s - j*b_s
    # conj(Y_ij + j*bc/2) = g_s - j*(b_s + bc/2)
    #
    # Term1 = [g_s - j*(b_s+bc/2)] * Vm2_i / tap2
    #   Re: g_s * Vm2_i / tap2
    #
    # Term2 = -[g_s - j*b_s] * [Vi*Vj*/T]
    #   Vi*Vj*/T = (A*tc + B*ts)/tap2 + j*(B*tc - A*ts)/tap2
    #   [g_s - j*b_s] * [(A*tc+B*ts)/tap2 + j*(B*tc-A*ts)/tap2]
    #     Re: [g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(B*tc-A*ts)] / tap2
    #   So -Term2 Re: -[g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(B*tc-A*ts)] / tap2
    #
    # Pf = g_s*Vm2_i/tap2 - [g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(B*tc-A*ts)] / tap2

    Pf = g_s * Vm2_i / tap2 \
         - (g_s * (A*tc + B*ts) + b_s * (B*tc - A*ts)) / tap2
    return Pf


def Qf_expr(model, k):
    """Reactive power flow from bus (from side)"""
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    g_s = br["y_re"]
    b_s = br["y_im"]
    bc = br["bc"]
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift = br["shift"]
    tap2 = tap * tap
    tc = tap * math.cos(shift)
    ts = tap * math.sin(shift)

    Vri = model.Vr[i]
    Vii = model.Vi[i]
    Vrj = model.Vr[j]
    Vij = model.Vi[j]

    Vm2_i = Vri**2 + Vii**2
    A = Vri * Vrj + Vii * Vij
    B = Vii * Vrj - Vri * Vij

    # Term1 Im: -(b_s+bc/2) * Vm2_i / tap2
    # Term2: -[g_s - j*b_s] * Vi*Vj*/T
    #   Im of [g_s - j*b_s]*[X + jY] = g_s*Y - b_s*X
    #   where X = (A*tc+B*ts)/tap2, Y = (B*tc-A*ts)/tap2
    #   So -Term2 Im: -[g_s*(B*tc-A*ts) - b_s*(A*tc+B*ts)] / tap2

    Qf = -(b_s + bc/2) * Vm2_i / tap2 \
         - (g_s * (B*tc - A*ts) - b_s * (A*tc + B*ts)) / tap2
    return Qf


def Pt_expr(model, k):
    """Real power flow to bus (to side)"""
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    g_s = br["y_re"]
    b_s = br["y_im"]
    bc = br["bc"]
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift = br["shift"]
    tap2 = tap * tap
    tc = tap * math.cos(shift)
    ts = tap * math.sin(shift)

    Vri = model.Vr[i]
    Vii = model.Vi[i]
    Vrj = model.Vr[j]
    Vij = model.Vi[j]

    Vm2_j = Vrj**2 + Vij**2
    # For to-side:
    # S_ji = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ji) * |Vj|^2  -  conj(Y_ij) * conj(Vi)*Vj / conj(T)
    # conj(Vi)*Vj = A - jB  (where A,B defined as before for Vi*Vj*)
    # 1/conj(T) = 1/(tc - j*ts) = (tc + j*ts)/tap2
    # conj(Vi)*Vj / conj(T) = (A-jB)*(tc+j*ts)/tap2
    #   = [A*tc + B*ts + j*(A*ts - B*tc)] / tap2

    A = Vri * Vrj + Vii * Vij
    B = Vii * Vrj - Vri * Vij

    # Term1 = [g_s - j*(b_s+bc/2)] * Vm2_j
    #   Re: g_s * Vm2_j
    # Term2 = -[g_s - j*b_s] * [(A*tc+B*ts)/tap2 + j*(A*ts-B*tc)/tap2]
    #   Re: -[g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(A*ts - B*tc)] / tap2
    # Wait, let me be more careful:
    #   [g_s - j*b_s] * [X + jY] where X=(A*tc+B*ts)/tap2, Y=(A*ts-B*tc)/tap2
    #   Re = g_s*X + b_s*Y = [g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(A*ts-B*tc)] / tap2
    #   So -Term2 Re = -[g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(A*ts-B*tc)] / tap2

    Pt = g_s * Vm2_j \
         - (g_s * (A*tc + B*ts) + b_s * (A*ts - B*tc)) / tap2
    return Pt


def Qt_expr(model, k):
    """Reactive power flow to bus (to side)"""
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    g_s = br["y_re"]
    b_s = br["y_im"]
    bc = br["bc"]
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift = br["shift"]
    tap2 = tap * tap
    tc = tap * math.cos(shift)
    ts = tap * math.sin(shift)

    Vri = model.Vr[i]
    Vii = model.Vi[i]
    Vrj = model.Vr[j]
    Vij = model.Vi[j]

    Vm2_j = Vrj**2 + Vij**2
    A = Vri * Vrj + Vii * Vij
    B = Vii * Vrj - Vri * Vij

    # Term1 Im: -(b_s+bc/2) * Vm2_j
    # Term2 = -[g_s - j*b_s]*[X+jY] where X=(A*tc+B*ts)/tap2, Y=(A*ts-B*tc)/tap2
    #   Im of [g_s-j*b_s]*[X+jY] = g_s*Y - b_s*X
    #   So -Term2 Im = -[g_s*(A*ts-B*tc) - b_s*(A*tc+B*ts)] / tap2

    Qt = -(b_s + bc/2) * Vm2_j \
         - (g_s * (A*ts - B*tc) - b_s * (A*tc + B*ts)) / tap2
    return Qt


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize cost = sum c2*(Pg*baseMVA)^2 + c1*(Pg*baseMVA) + c0
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def obj_rule(model):
    return sum(
        gen_cost[k]["c2"] * (model.Pg[k] * baseMVA)**2
        + gen_cost[k]["c1"] * (model.Pg[k] * baseMVA)
        + gen_cost[k]["c0"]
        for k in gen_ids
    )

model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Reference bus angle = 0  =>  Vi_r = 0
def ref_angle_rule(model, r):
    return model.Vi[r] == 0.0
model.ref_angle = pyo.Constraint(ref_buses, rule=ref_angle_rule)

# Voltage magnitude bounds: vmin^2 <= Vr^2 + Vi^2 <= vmax^2
def vmin_rule(model, i):
    return model.Vr[i]**2 + model.Vi[i]**2 >= buses[i]["vmin"]**2
def vmax_rule(model, i):
    return model.Vr[i]**2 + model.Vi[i]**2 <= buses[i]["vmax"]**2
model.vmin_con = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=vmin_rule)
model.vmax_con = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=vmax_rule)

# Nodal power balance
def p_balance_rule(model, i):
    # Generation - Load - Shunt = sum of branch flows
    pg_sum = sum(model.Pg[k] for k in bus_gens[i]) if bus_gens[i] else 0.0
    pd = buses[i]["Pd"]
    gs = buses[i]["Gs"]
    Vm2 = model.Vr[i]**2 + model.Vi[i]**2
    shunt_p = gs * Vm2  # Re(Ys* |Vi|^2) where Ys = gs + j*bs => Ys* = gs - j*bs

    flow_sum = 0.0
    for (k, is_from) in bus_branches[i]:
        if is_from:
            flow_sum += Pf_expr(model, k)
        else:
            flow_sum += Pt_expr(model, k)

    return pg_sum - pd - shunt_p == flow_sum

def q_balance_rule(model, i):
    qg_sum = sum(model.Qg[k] for k in bus_gens[i]) if bus_gens[i] else 0.0
    qd = buses[i]["Qd"]
    bs = buses[i]["Bs"]
    Vm2 = model.Vr[i]**2 + model.Vi[i]**2
    shunt_q = -bs * Vm2  # Im(Ys* |Vi|^2) = -bs*|V|^2

    flow_sum = 0.0
    for (k, is_from) in bus_branches[i]:
        if is_from:
            flow_sum += Qf_expr(model, k)
        else:
            flow_sum += Qt_expr(model, k)

    return qg_sum - qd - shunt_q == flow_sum

model.p_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=p_balance_rule)
model.q_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=q_balance_rule)

# Branch flow limits (MVA): |Sf|^2 <= (rateA)^2 and |St|^2 <= (rateA)^2
def sf_limit_rule(model, k):
    br = branches[k]
    if br["rateA"] <= 0:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    return Pf_expr(model, k)**2 + Qf_expr(model, k)**2 <= br["rateA"]**2

def st_limit_rule(model, k):
    br = branches[k]
    if br["rateA"] <= 0:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    return Pt_expr(model, k)**2 + Qt_expr(model, k)**2 <= br["rateA"]**2

model.sf_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.E, rule=sf_limit_rule)
model.st_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.E, rule=st_limit_rule)

# Angle difference constraints
def angdiff_min_rule(model, k):
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    # angle(Vi*Vj*) = atan2(Im(Vi*Vj*), Re(Vi*Vj*))
    # For small angles, we can use the linear approximation:
    # Im(Vi*Vj*) >= tan(angmin) * Re(Vi*Vj*)
    # But for robustness, use: Vi_i*Vr_j - Vr_i*Vi_j >= tan(angmin)*(Vr_i*Vr_j + Vi_i*Vi_j)
    # if angmin >= -pi/2 (which it is for typical -30 deg)
    angmin = br["angmin"]
    if angmin <= -math.pi/2 + 0.01:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    ta = math.tan(angmin)
    A = model.Vr[i]*model.Vr[j] + model.Vi[i]*model.Vi[j]
    B = model.Vi[i]*model.Vr[j] - model.Vr[i]*model.Vi[j]
    return B >= ta * A

def angdiff_max_rule(model, k):
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    angmax = br["angmax"]
    if angmax >= math.pi/2 - 0.01:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    ta = math.tan(angmax)
    A = model.Vr[i]*model.Vr[j] + model.Vi[i]*model.Vi[j]
    B = model.Vi[i]*model.Vr[j] - model.Vr[i]*model.Vi[j]
    return B <= ta * A

model.angdiff_min = pyo.Constraint(model.E, rule=angdiff_min_rule)
model.angdiff_max = pyo.Constraint(model.E, rule=angdiff_max_rule)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Solve
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Building model complete. Solving with IPOPT...")

solver = pyo.SolverFactory("ipopt", executable="/root/.idaes/bin/ipopt")
solver.options["max_iter"] = 5000
solver.options["tol"] = 1e-6
solver.options["acceptable_tol"] = 1e-5
solver.options["print_level"] = 5
solver.options["linear_solver"] = "mumps"
solver.options["mu_init"] = 1e-2

results = solver.solve(model, tee=True)

status = str(results.solver.termination_condition)
print(f"\nSolver status: {status}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract results and build report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Bus results
bus_results = []
for i in bus_ids:
    vr = pyo.value(model.Vr[i])
    vi = pyo.value(model.Vi[i])
    vm = math.sqrt(vr**2 + vi**2)
    va = math.degrees(math.atan2(vi, vr))
    bus_results.append({
        "id": i,
        "vm_pu": round(vm, 6),
        "va_deg": round(va, 6),
        "vmin_pu": buses[i]["vmin"],
        "vmax_pu": buses[i]["vmax"],
    })

# Generator results
gen_results = []
for k in gen_ids:
    g = gens[k]
    pg = pyo.value(model.Pg[k]) * baseMVA
    qg = pyo.value(model.Qg[k]) * baseMVA
    gen_results.append({
        "id": g["id"],
        "bus": g["bus"],
        "pg_MW": round(pg, 4),
        "qg_MVAr": round(qg, 4),
        "pmin_MW": round(g["Pmin"] * baseMVA, 4),
        "pmax_MW": round(g["Pmax"] * baseMVA, 4),
        "qmin_MVAr": round(g["Qmin"] * baseMVA, 4),
        "qmax_MVAr": round(g["Qmax"] * baseMVA, 4),
    })

# Branch flows and loading
branch_results = []
for k in branch_ids:
    br = branches[k]
    pf = pyo.value(Pf_expr(model, k)) * baseMVA
    qf = pyo.value(Qf_expr(model, k)) * baseMVA
    pt = pyo.value(Pt_expr(model, k)) * baseMVA
    qt = pyo.value(Qt_expr(model, k)) * baseMVA

    sf = math.sqrt(pf**2 + qf**2)
    st = math.sqrt(pt**2 + qt**2)
    limit = br["rateA"] * baseMVA

    loading = max(sf, st) / limit * 100.0 if limit > 0 else 0.0

    branch_results.append({
        "from_bus": br["fbus"],
        "to_bus": br["tbus"],
        "loading_pct": round(loading, 4),
        "flow_from_MVA": round(sf, 4),
        "flow_to_MVA": round(st, 4),
        "limit_MVA": round(limit, 4),
    })

# Top 10 most loaded branches
branch_results.sort(key=lambda x: x["loading_pct"], reverse=True)
most_loaded = branch_results[:10]

# Summary
total_pg = sum(r["pg_MW"] for r in gen_results)
total_qg = sum(r["qg_MVAr"] for r in gen_results)
total_pd_mw = sum(buses[i]["Pd"] for i in bus_ids) * baseMVA
total_qd_mvar = sum(buses[i]["Qd"] for i in bus_ids) * baseMVA
total_losses = total_pg - total_pd_mw

cost = pyo.value(model.obj)

# Feasibility checks
# P and Q mismatch at each bus
max_p_mismatch = 0.0
max_q_mismatch = 0.0
for i in bus_ids:
    pg_sum = sum(pyo.value(model.Pg[k]) for k in bus_gens[i]) if bus_gens[i] else 0.0
    pd = buses[i]["Pd"]
    gs = buses[i]["Gs"]
    bs = buses[i]["Bs"]
    vr = pyo.value(model.Vr[i])
    vi = pyo.value(model.Vi[i])
    vm2 = vr**2 + vi**2

    flow_p = 0.0
    flow_q = 0.0
    for (k, is_from) in bus_branches[i]:
        if is_from:
            flow_p += pyo.value(Pf_expr(model, k))
            flow_q += pyo.value(Qf_expr(model, k))
        else:
            flow_p += pyo.value(Pt_expr(model, k))
            flow_q += pyo.value(Qt_expr(model, k))

    qg_sum = sum(pyo.value(model.Qg[k]) for k in bus_gens[i]) if bus_gens[i] else 0.0

    p_mis = abs(pg_sum - pd - gs*vm2 - flow_p) * baseMVA
    q_mis = abs(qg_sum - buses[i]["Qd"] - (-bs*vm2) - flow_q) * baseMVA

    max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, p_mis)
    max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, q_mis)

# Voltage violations
max_v_viol = 0.0
for i in bus_ids:
    vr = pyo.value(model.Vr[i])
    vi = pyo.value(model.Vi[i])
    vm = math.sqrt(vr**2 + vi**2)
    viol = max(0, vm - buses[i]["vmax"], buses[i]["vmin"] - vm)
    max_v_viol = max(max_v_viol, viol)

# Branch overload
max_branch_overload = 0.0
for br_res in branch_results:
    limit = br_res["limit_MVA"]
    if limit > 0:
        overload_from = max(0, br_res["flow_from_MVA"] - limit)
        overload_to = max(0, br_res["flow_to_MVA"] - limit)
        max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, overload_from, overload_to)

# Map solver status
if "optimal" in status.lower():
    solver_status = "optimal"
elif "feasible" in status.lower():
    solver_status = "feasible"
else:
    solver_status = status

report = {
    "summary": {
        "total_cost_per_hour": round(cost, 2),
        "total_load_MW": round(total_pd_mw, 2),
        "total_load_MVAr": round(total_qd_mvar, 2),
        "total_generation_MW": round(total_pg, 2),
        "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_qg, 2),
        "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses, 2),
        "solver_status": solver_status,
    },
    "generators": gen_results,
    "buses": bus_results,
    "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded,
    "feasibility_check": {
        "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
        "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
        "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_viol, 6),
        "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_branch_overload, 6),
    },
}

with open("/root/report.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"REPORT SUMMARY")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"Total cost ($/hr):     {report['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:,.2f}")
print(f"Total load:            {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:,.2f} MW / {report['summary']['total_load_MVAr']:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total generation:      {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:,.2f} MW / {report['summary']['total_generation_MVAr']:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total losses:          {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:,.2f} MW")
print(f"Solver status:         {report['summary']['solver_status']}")
print(f"Max P mismatch:        {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
print(f"Max Q mismatch:        {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MW")
print(f"Max voltage violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
print(f"Max branch overload:   {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.6f} MVA")
print(f"\nTop 5 most loaded branches:")
for br in most_loaded[:5]:
    print(f"  {br['from_bus']}->{br['to_bus']}: {br['loading_pct']:.1f}% ({br['flow_from_MVA']:.1f}/{br['limit_MVA']:.1f} MVA)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) solver using Pyomo + IPOPT.

Implements the complex-power AC-OPF formulation from math-model.md
using rectangular voltage coordinates (Vr, Vi) for smooth NLP.
"""

import json
import math
import numpy as np
import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
with open("/root/network.json") as f:
    raw = json.load(f)

baseMVA = raw["baseMVA"]

# --- buses ---
buses = {}
for b in raw["bus"]:
    bid = int(b[0])
    buses[bid] = {
        "type": int(b[1]),   # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Ref
        "Pd": b[2] / baseMVA,
        "Qd": b[3] / baseMVA,
        "Gs": b[4] / baseMVA,
        "Bs": b[5] / baseMVA,
        "Vm": b[7],
        "Va": math.radians(b[8]),
        "vmax": b[11],
        "vmin": b[12],
    }

bus_ids = sorted(buses.keys())
ref_buses = [i for i in bus_ids if buses[i]["type"] == 3]

# --- generators ---
gens = []
gen_cost = []
for idx, (g, gc) in enumerate(zip(raw["gen"], raw["gencost"])):
    if g[7] == 0.0:  # skip out-of-service
        continue
    gens.append({
        "id": idx + 1,
        "bus": int(g[0]),
        "Pg": g[1] / baseMVA,
        "Qg": g[2] / baseMVA,
        "Qmax": g[3] / baseMVA,
        "Qmin": g[4] / baseMVA,
        "Vg": g[5],
        "Pmax": g[8] / baseMVA,
        "Pmin": g[9] / baseMVA,
    })
    # polynomial cost: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0  (Pg in MW for cost)
    # ncost = int(gc[3])
    gen_cost.append({
        "c2": gc[4],
        "c1": gc[5],
        "c0": gc[6],
    })

gen_ids = list(range(len(gens)))

# Map bus -> list of generator indices
bus_gens = {i: [] for i in bus_ids}
for k, g in enumerate(gens):
    bus_gens[g["bus"]].append(k)

# --- branches ---
branches = []
for b in raw["branch"]:
    if b[10] == 0.0:  # skip out-of-service
        continue
    fbus = int(b[0])
    tbus = int(b[1])
    r = b[2]
    x = b[3]
    bc = b[4]  # total line charging susceptance
    rateA = b[5] / baseMVA  # MVA limit in pu
    tap = b[8]
    shift = math.radians(b[9])
    angmin = math.radians(b[11])
    angmax = math.radians(b[12])

    if tap == 0.0:
        tap = 1.0  # default tap

    # Series admittance
    z = complex(r, x)
    y = 1.0 / z if abs(z) > 0 else complex(0, 0)

    # Pi-model parameters
    # Y_ij = y (series admittance)
    # Y^c_ij = j*bc/2  (from-side charging)
    # Y^c_ji = j*bc/2  (to-side charging)
    # T_ij = tap * exp(j*shift)

    branches.append({
        "fbus": fbus,
        "tbus": tbus,
        "y_re": y.real,
        "y_im": y.imag,
        "bc": bc,       # total charging
        "rateA": rateA,
        "tap": tap,
        "shift": shift,
        "angmin": angmin,
        "angmax": angmax,
    })

branch_ids = list(range(len(branches)))

# Bus -> list of (branch_idx, is_from)
bus_branches = {i: [] for i in bus_ids}
for k, br in enumerate(branches):
    bus_branches[br["fbus"]].append((k, True))
    bus_branches[br["tbus"]].append((k, False))

print(f"System: {len(bus_ids)} buses, {len(gens)} generators, {len(branches)} branches")
print(f"Reference bus(es): {ref_buses}")
total_pd = sum(buses[i]["Pd"] for i in bus_ids) * baseMVA
total_qd = sum(buses[i]["Qd"] for i in bus_ids) * baseMVA
print(f"Total load: {total_pd:.2f} MW, {total_qd:.2f} MVAr")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build Pyomo Model  (rectangular V formulation)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pyo.ConcreteModel("ACOPF")

# Sets
model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=bus_ids)
model.G = pyo.Set(initialize=gen_ids)
model.E = pyo.Set(initialize=branch_ids)

# Variables
model.Vr = pyo.Var(model.N, initialize=1.0)  # real part of voltage
model.Vi = pyo.Var(model.N, initialize=0.0)  # imaginary part

model.Pg = pyo.Var(model.G, initialize=0.5)
model.Qg = pyo.Var(model.G, initialize=0.0)

# Initialize voltages from flat start / data
for i in bus_ids:
    vm = buses[i]["Vm"]
    va = buses[i]["Va"]
    model.Vr[i].value = vm * math.cos(va)
    model.Vi[i].value = vm * math.sin(va)

# Initialize generators
for k in gen_ids:
    model.Pg[k].value = gens[k]["Pg"]
    model.Qg[k].value = gens[k]["Qg"]

# Generator bounds
for k in gen_ids:
    model.Pg[k].setlb(gens[k]["Pmin"])
    model.Pg[k].setub(gens[k]["Pmax"])
    model.Qg[k].setlb(gens[k]["Qmin"])
    model.Qg[k].setub(gens[k]["Qmax"])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Branch power flow expressions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For branch k from bus i to bus j:
#   T = tap * exp(j*shift) = tap*(cos(shift) + j*sin(shift))
#   |T|^2 = tap^2
#
# S_ij = (y + j*bc/2)* |Vi|^2 / |T|^2  -  y* Vi*Vj* / T
# S_ji = (y + j*bc/2)* |Vj|^2           -  y* Vi**Vj / T*
#
# In rectangular coordinates, V_i = Vr_i + j*Vi_i:
#   |V_i|^2 = Vr_i^2 + Vi_i^2
#   V_i * V_j* = (Vr_i*Vr_j + Vi_i*Vi_j) + j*(Vi_i*Vr_j - Vr_i*Vi_j)
#   V_i * V_j* / T = [(Vr_i*Vr_j + Vi_i*Vi_j)*(tc) + (Vi_i*Vr_j - Vr_i*Vi_j)*(ts)] / tap^2
#                   + j*[(Vi_i*Vr_j - Vr_i*Vi_j)*(tc) - (Vr_i*Vr_j + Vi_i*Vi_j)*(ts)] / tap^2
#   where tc = tap*cos(shift), ts = tap*sin(shift)

def Pf_expr(model, k):
    """Real power flow from bus (from side)"""
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    g_s = br["y_re"]  # series conductance
    b_s = br["y_im"]  # series susceptance
    bc = br["bc"]
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift = br["shift"]
    tap2 = tap * tap
    tc = tap * math.cos(shift)
    ts = tap * math.sin(shift)

    Vri = model.Vr[i]
    Vii = model.Vi[i]
    Vrj = model.Vr[j]
    Vij = model.Vi[j]

    Vm2_i = Vri**2 + Vii**2
    # Real part of (y + j*bc/2)* = g_s - j*(b_s + bc/2) ... conjugate
    # (y + j*bc/2)* |Vi|^2 / |T|^2
    # Re: g_s * Vm2_i / tap2
    # Im: -(b_s + bc/2) * Vm2_i / tap2

    # V_i * V_j* / T:
    # Let A = Vri*Vrj + Vii*Vij  (Re of Vi*Vj*)
    # Let B = Vii*Vrj - Vri*Vij  (Im of Vi*Vj*)
    # Vi*Vj*/T = (A*tc + B*ts)/tap2 + j*(B*tc - A*ts)/tap2
    A = Vri * Vrj + Vii * Vij
    B = Vii * Vrj - Vri * Vij

    # S_ij = (g_s - j(b_s+bc/2)) * Vm2_i / tap2  -  (g_s - j*b_s) * [Vi*Vj*/T]
    # Re(S_ij):
    Pf = g_s * Vm2_i / tap2 \
         - g_s * (A * tc + B * ts) / tap2 \
         - (-b_s) * (B * tc - A * ts) / tap2
    # Note: y* = g_s - j*b_s, so Re(-y* * (X+jY)) = -g_s*X + b_s*Y
    # Correction: -y* * Z = -(g_s - j*b_s)*(X+jY) = -g_s*X - b_s*(-Y) ... let me redo carefully
    # Actually: S_ij = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ij) * |Vi|^2/|T|^2  -  conj(Y_ij) * Vi*Vj*/T
    # conj(Y_ij) = g_s - j*b_s
    # conj(Y_ij + j*bc/2) = g_s - j*(b_s + bc/2)
    #
    # Term1 = [g_s - j*(b_s+bc/2)] * Vm2_i / tap2
    #   Re: g_s * Vm2_i / tap2
    #
    # Term2 = -[g_s - j*b_s] * [Vi*Vj*/T]
    #   Vi*Vj*/T = (A*tc + B*ts)/tap2 + j*(B*tc - A*ts)/tap2
    #   [g_s - j*b_s] * [(A*tc+B*ts)/tap2 + j*(B*tc-A*ts)/tap2]
    #     Re: [g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(B*tc-A*ts)] / tap2
    #   So -Term2 Re: -[g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(B*tc-A*ts)] / tap2
    #
    # Pf = g_s*Vm2_i/tap2 - [g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(B*tc-A*ts)] / tap2

    Pf = g_s * Vm2_i / tap2 \
         - (g_s * (A*tc + B*ts) + b_s * (B*tc - A*ts)) / tap2
    return Pf


def Qf_expr(model, k):
    """Reactive power flow from bus (from side)"""
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    g_s = br["y_re"]
    b_s = br["y_im"]
    bc = br["bc"]
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift = br["shift"]
    tap2 = tap * tap
    tc = tap * math.cos(shift)
    ts = tap * math.sin(shift)

    Vri = model.Vr[i]
    Vii = model.Vi[i]
    Vrj = model.Vr[j]
    Vij = model.Vi[j]

    Vm2_i = Vri**2 + Vii**2
    A = Vri * Vrj + Vii * Vij
    B = Vii * Vrj - Vri * Vij

    # Term1 Im: -(b_s+bc/2) * Vm2_i / tap2
    # Term2: -[g_s - j*b_s] * Vi*Vj*/T
    #   Im of [g_s - j*b_s]*[X + jY] = g_s*Y - b_s*X
    #   where X = (A*tc+B*ts)/tap2, Y = (B*tc-A*ts)/tap2
    #   So -Term2 Im: -[g_s*(B*tc-A*ts) - b_s*(A*tc+B*ts)] / tap2

    Qf = -(b_s + bc/2) * Vm2_i / tap2 \
         - (g_s * (B*tc - A*ts) - b_s * (A*tc + B*ts)) / tap2
    return Qf


def Pt_expr(model, k):
    """Real power flow to bus (to side)"""
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    g_s = br["y_re"]
    b_s = br["y_im"]
    bc = br["bc"]
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift = br["shift"]
    tap2 = tap * tap
    tc = tap * math.cos(shift)
    ts = tap * math.sin(shift)

    Vri = model.Vr[i]
    Vii = model.Vi[i]
    Vrj = model.Vr[j]
    Vij = model.Vi[j]

    Vm2_j = Vrj**2 + Vij**2
    # For to-side:
    # S_ji = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ji) * |Vj|^2  -  conj(Y_ij) * conj(Vi)*Vj / conj(T)
    # conj(Vi)*Vj = A - jB  (where A,B defined as before for Vi*Vj*)
    # 1/conj(T) = 1/(tc - j*ts) = (tc + j*ts)/tap2
    # conj(Vi)*Vj / conj(T) = (A-jB)*(tc+j*ts)/tap2
    #   = [A*tc + B*ts + j*(A*ts - B*tc)] / tap2

    A = Vri * Vrj + Vii * Vij
    B = Vii * Vrj - Vri * Vij

    # Term1 = [g_s - j*(b_s+bc/2)] * Vm2_j
    #   Re: g_s * Vm2_j
    # Term2 = -[g_s - j*b_s] * [(A*tc+B*ts)/tap2 + j*(A*ts-B*tc)/tap2]
    #   Re: -[g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(A*ts - B*tc)] / tap2
    # Wait, let me be more careful:
    #   [g_s - j*b_s] * [X + jY] where X=(A*tc+B*ts)/tap2, Y=(A*ts-B*tc)/tap2
    #   Re = g_s*X + b_s*Y = [g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(A*ts-B*tc)] / tap2
    #   So -Term2 Re = -[g_s*(A*tc+B*ts) + b_s*(A*ts-B*tc)] / tap2

    Pt = g_s * Vm2_j \
         - (g_s * (A*tc + B*ts) + b_s * (A*ts - B*tc)) / tap2
    return Pt


def Qt_expr(model, k):
    """Reactive power flow to bus (to side)"""
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    g_s = br["y_re"]
    b_s = br["y_im"]
    bc = br["bc"]
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift = br["shift"]
    tap2 = tap * tap
    tc = tap * math.cos(shift)
    ts = tap * math.sin(shift)

    Vri = model.Vr[i]
    Vii = model.Vi[i]
    Vrj = model.Vr[j]
    Vij = model.Vi[j]

    Vm2_j = Vrj**2 + Vij**2
    A = Vri * Vrj + Vii * Vij
    B = Vii * Vrj - Vri * Vij

    # Term1 Im: -(b_s+bc/2) * Vm2_j
    # Term2 = -[g_s - j*b_s]*[X+jY] where X=(A*tc+B*ts)/tap2, Y=(A*ts-B*tc)/tap2
    #   Im of [g_s-j*b_s]*[X+jY] = g_s*Y - b_s*X
    #   So -Term2 Im = -[g_s*(A*ts-B*tc) - b_s*(A*tc+B*ts)] / tap2

    Qt = -(b_s + bc/2) * Vm2_j \
         - (g_s * (A*ts - B*tc) - b_s * (A*tc + B*ts)) / tap2
    return Qt


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize cost = sum c2*(Pg*baseMVA)^2 + c1*(Pg*baseMVA) + c0
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def obj_rule(model):
    return sum(
        gen_cost[k]["c2"] * (model.Pg[k] * baseMVA)**2
        + gen_cost[k]["c1"] * (model.Pg[k] * baseMVA)
        + gen_cost[k]["c0"]
        for k in gen_ids
    )

model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Reference bus angle = 0  =>  Vi_r = 0
def ref_angle_rule(model, r):
    return model.Vi[r] == 0.0
model.ref_angle = pyo.Constraint(ref_buses, rule=ref_angle_rule)

# Voltage magnitude bounds: vmin^2 <= Vr^2 + Vi^2 <= vmax^2
def vmin_rule(model, i):
    return model.Vr[i]**2 + model.Vi[i]**2 >= buses[i]["vmin"]**2
def vmax_rule(model, i):
    return model.Vr[i]**2 + model.Vi[i]**2 <= buses[i]["vmax"]**2
model.vmin_con = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=vmin_rule)
model.vmax_con = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=vmax_rule)

# Nodal power balance
def p_balance_rule(model, i):
    # Generation - Load - Shunt = sum of branch flows
    pg_sum = sum(model.Pg[k] for k in bus_gens[i]) if bus_gens[i] else 0.0
    pd = buses[i]["Pd"]
    gs = buses[i]["Gs"]
    Vm2 = model.Vr[i]**2 + model.Vi[i]**2
    shunt_p = gs * Vm2  # Re(Ys* |Vi|^2) where Ys = gs + j*bs => Ys* = gs - j*bs

    flow_sum = 0.0
    for (k, is_from) in bus_branches[i]:
        if is_from:
            flow_sum += Pf_expr(model, k)
        else:
            flow_sum += Pt_expr(model, k)

    return pg_sum - pd - shunt_p == flow_sum

def q_balance_rule(model, i):
    qg_sum = sum(model.Qg[k] for k in bus_gens[i]) if bus_gens[i] else 0.0
    qd = buses[i]["Qd"]
    bs = buses[i]["Bs"]
    Vm2 = model.Vr[i]**2 + model.Vi[i]**2
    shunt_q = -bs * Vm2  # Im(Ys* |Vi|^2) = -bs*|V|^2

    flow_sum = 0.0
    for (k, is_from) in bus_branches[i]:
        if is_from:
            flow_sum += Qf_expr(model, k)
        else:
            flow_sum += Qt_expr(model, k)

    return qg_sum - qd - shunt_q == flow_sum

model.p_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=p_balance_rule)
model.q_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=q_balance_rule)

# Branch flow limits (MVA): |Sf|^2 <= (rateA)^2 and |St|^2 <= (rateA)^2
def sf_limit_rule(model, k):
    br = branches[k]
    if br["rateA"] <= 0:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    return Pf_expr(model, k)**2 + Qf_expr(model, k)**2 <= br["rateA"]**2

def st_limit_rule(model, k):
    br = branches[k]
    if br["rateA"] <= 0:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    return Pt_expr(model, k)**2 + Qt_expr(model, k)**2 <= br["rateA"]**2

model.sf_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.E, rule=sf_limit_rule)
model.st_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.E, rule=st_limit_rule)

# Angle difference constraints
def angdiff_min_rule(model, k):
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    # angle(Vi*Vj*) = atan2(Im(Vi*Vj*), Re(Vi*Vj*))
    # For small angles, we can use the linear approximation:
    # Im(Vi*Vj*) >= tan(angmin) * Re(Vi*Vj*)
    # But for robustness, use: Vi_i*Vr_j - Vr_i*Vi_j >= tan(angmin)*(Vr_i*Vr_j + Vi_i*Vi_j)
    # if angmin >= -pi/2 (which it is for typical -30 deg)
    angmin = br["angmin"]
    if angmin <= -math.pi/2 + 0.01:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    ta = math.tan(angmin)
    A = model.Vr[i]*model.Vr[j] + model.Vi[i]*model.Vi[j]
    B = model.Vi[i]*model.Vr[j] - model.Vr[i]*model.Vi[j]
    return B >= ta * A

def angdiff_max_rule(model, k):
    br = branches[k]
    i = br["fbus"]
    j = br["tbus"]
    angmax = br["angmax"]
    if angmax >= math.pi/2 - 0.01:
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    ta = math.tan(angmax)
    A = model.Vr[i]*model.Vr[j] + model.Vi[i]*model.Vi[j]
    B = model.Vi[i]*model.Vr[j] - model.Vr[i]*model.Vi[j]
    return B <= ta * A

model.angdiff_min = pyo.Constraint(model.E, rule=angdiff_min_rule)
model.angdiff_max = pyo.Constraint(model.E, rule=angdiff_max_rule)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Solve
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Building model complete. Solving with IPOPT...")

solver = pyo.SolverFactory("ipopt", executable="/root/.idaes/bin/ipopt")
solver.options["max_iter"] = 5000
solver.options["tol"] = 1e-6
solver.options["acceptable_tol"] = 1e-5
solver.options["print_level"] = 5
solver.options["linear_solver"] = "mumps"
solver.options["mu_init"] = 1e-2

results = solver.solve(model, tee=True)

status = str(results.solver.termination_condition)
print(f"\nSolver status: {status}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract results and build report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Bus results
bus_results = []
for i in bus_ids:
    vr = pyo.value(model.Vr[i])
    vi = pyo.value(model.Vi[i])
    vm = math.sqrt(vr**2 + vi**2)
    va = math.degrees(math.atan2(vi, vr))
    bus_results.append({
        "id": i,
        "vm_pu": round(vm, 6),
        "va_deg": round(va, 6),
        "vmin_pu": buses[i]["vmin"],
        "vmax_pu": buses[i]["vmax"],
    })

# Generator results
gen_results = []
for k in gen_ids:
    g = gens[k]
    pg = pyo.value(model.Pg[k]) * baseMVA
    qg = pyo.value(model.Qg[k]) * baseMVA
    gen_results.append({
        "id": g["id"],
        "bus": g["bus"],
        "pg_MW": round(pg, 4),
        "qg_MVAr": round(qg, 4),
        "pmin_MW": round(g["Pmin"] * baseMVA, 4),
        "pmax_MW": round(g["Pmax"] * baseMVA, 4),
        "qmin_MVAr": round(g["Qmin"] * baseMVA, 4),
        "qmax_MVAr": round(g["Qmax"] * baseMVA, 4),
    })

# Branch flows and loading
branch_results = []
for k in branch_ids:
    br = branches[k]
    pf = pyo.value(Pf_expr(model, k)) * baseMVA
    qf = pyo.value(Qf_expr(model, k)) * baseMVA
    pt = pyo.value(Pt_expr(model, k)) * baseMVA
    qt = pyo.value(Qt_expr(model, k)) * baseMVA

    sf = math.sqrt(pf**2 + qf**2)
    st = math.sqrt(pt**2 + qt**2)
    limit = br["rateA"] * baseMVA

    loading = max(sf, st) / limit * 100.0 if limit > 0 else 0.0

    branch_results.append({
        "from_bus": br["fbus"],
        "to_bus": br["tbus"],
        "loading_pct": round(loading, 4),
        "flow_from_MVA": round(sf, 4),
        "flow_to_MVA": round(st, 4),
        "limit_MVA": round(limit, 4),
    })

# Top 10 most loaded branches
branch_results.sort(key=lambda x: x["loading_pct"], reverse=True)
most_loaded = branch_results[:10]

# Summary
total_pg = sum(r["pg_MW"] for r in gen_results)
total_qg = sum(r["qg_MVAr"] for r in gen_results)
total_pd_mw = sum(buses[i]["Pd"] for i in bus_ids) * baseMVA
total_qd_mvar = sum(buses[i]["Qd"] for i in bus_ids) * baseMVA
total_losses = total_pg - total_pd_mw

cost = pyo.value(model.obj)

# Feasibility checks
# P and Q mismatch at each bus
max_p_mismatch = 0.0
max_q_mismatch = 0.0
for i in bus_ids:
    pg_sum = sum(pyo.value(model.Pg[k]) for k in bus_gens[i]) if bus_gens[i] else 0.0
    pd = buses[i]["Pd"]
    gs = buses[i]["Gs"]
    bs = buses[i]["Bs"]
    vr = pyo.value(model.Vr[i])
    vi = pyo.value(model.Vi[i])
    vm2 = vr**2 + vi**2

    flow_p = 0.0
    flow_q = 0.0
    for (k, is_from) in bus_branches[i]:
        if is_from:
            flow_p += pyo.value(Pf_expr(model, k))
            flow_q += pyo.value(Qf_expr(model, k))
        else:
            flow_p += pyo.value(Pt_expr(model, k))
            flow_q += pyo.value(Qt_expr(model, k))

    qg_sum = sum(pyo.value(model.Qg[k]) for k in bus_gens[i]) if bus_gens[i] else 0.0

    p_mis = abs(pg_sum - pd - gs*vm2 - flow_p) * baseMVA
    q_mis = abs(qg_sum - buses[i]["Qd"] - (-bs*vm2) - flow_q) * baseMVA

    max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, p_mis)
    max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, q_mis)

# Voltage violations
max_v_viol = 0.0
for i in bus_ids:
    vr = pyo.value(model.Vr[i])
    vi = pyo.value(model.Vi[i])
    vm = math.sqrt(vr**2 + vi**2)
    viol = max(0, vm - buses[i]["vmax"], buses[i]["vmin"] - vm)
    max_v_viol = max(max_v_viol, viol)

# Branch overload
max_branch_overload = 0.0
for br_res in branch_results:
    limit = br_res["limit_MVA"]
    if limit > 0:
        overload_from = max(0, br_res["flow_from_MVA"] - limit)
        overload_to = max(0, br_res["flow_to_MVA"] - limit)
        max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, overload_from, overload_to)

# Map solver status
if "optimal" in status.lower():
    solver_status = "optimal"
elif "feasible" in status.lower():
    solver_status = "feasible"
else:
    solver_status = status

report = {
    "summary": {
        "total_cost_per_hour": round(cost, 2),
        "total_load_MW": round(total_pd_mw, 2),
        "total_load_MVAr": round(total_qd_mvar, 2),
        "total_generation_MW": round(total_pg, 2),
        "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_qg, 2),
        "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses, 2),
        "solver_status": solver_status,
    },
    "generators": gen_results,
    "buses": bus_results,
    "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded,
    "feasibility_check": {
        "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
        "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
        "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_viol, 6),
        "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_branch_overload, 6),
    },
}

with open("/root/report.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"REPORT SUMMARY")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"Total cost ($/hr):     {report['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:,.2f}")
print(f"Total load:            {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:,.2f} MW / {report['summary']['total_load_MVAr']:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total generation:      {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:,.2f} MW / {report['summary']['total_generation_MVAr']:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total losses:          {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:,.2f} MW")
print(f"Solver status:         {report['summary']['solver_status']}")
print(f"Max P mismatch:        {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
print(f"Max Q mismatch:        {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MW")
print(f"Max voltage violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
print(f"Max branch overload:   {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.6f} MVA")
print(f"\nTop 5 most loaded branches:")
for br in most_loaded[:5]:
    print(f"  {br['from_bus']}->{br['to_bus']}: {br['loading_pct']:.1f}% ({br['flow_from_MVA']:.1f}/{br['limit_MVA']:.1f} MVA)")
print(f"\nReport written to /root/report.json")
